parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the protection template.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection template to modify.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description:
The name of the protection template. The name must be 1 to 255 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

> Template names must be unique for the same protection scenario (**DefenseScene**).
